knowledge_at_design: Post-v2 and post-calibration-readout follow-up. The unchanged v2 endpoint is NOT_SUPPORTED. Calibration actual mean cosine was 0.12208 versus approximately 0.002 for both existing null families. The position-stratified null and response/geometry associations below have not yet been computed.

calibration.position_bins: Use the existing relative thirds: floor(3*token_index/(calibration_token_count-1)), capped at 2. No alternative bins.
calibration.stratified_shuffle: For each draw, iterate sorted (prompt_id, bin) groups and permute original node indices with default_rng(6043). Permute whole vectors, including their norms and zeros. Keep fixed points and singleton groups; never redraw. Targets, neighbors and weights stay unchanged.
calibration.common_mask: Intersect finite target-recovery cosines for actual and every draw of all three null families. Use identical nodes and equal prompt weighting for all arms. Report all and distance-supported scopes, excluded counts, and per-draw paired masks separately.
calibration.aggregation: Average nodes within prompt, then prompts equally, then fixed draws. Report draw q10/q90 as descriptive reference ranges, never as confidence intervals or significance tests.
calibration.scope: Donor-prompt-excluded reconstruction in a shared PCA chart, not fully held-out cross-validation. Coarse-bin preservation does not control exact position, token identity, syntax, or semantics. No semantic ground truth.

v2.source: Only frozen v2 support/hidden/logit/treatment artifacts. Start after a verified completed Stage A manifest; do not condition any analysis settings on Stage A values.
v2.primary: Replay the existing complete-grid signed endpoint and retain its original NOT_SUPPORTED verdict, bootstrap and prompt unit. No new confirmatory test.
v2.associations: Spearman correlation, report every predictor/outcome/scope, finite counts, no p-values or selection. Average eight seeds before defining a cell; pooled cells are repeated observations of 20 prompts, not 60 independent samples.
v2.positions: Query token_index=prefix_length-1. Compute weighted absolute token gap to calibration donors. Donor bin masses use calibration lengths only; never use future evaluation text length to bin the query.
v2.dose_response: For every component and fixed magnitude 0.25, 0.5, 1, record plus/minus baseline logprob deltas, odd=(delta_plus-delta_minus)/2, even=(delta_plus+delta_minus)/2. Average seeds, then prefixes, then prompts equally. Describe finite-dose responses, not infinitesimal derivatives or fluency.
v2.scope: Evaluation prefixes have no observed coexact ground truth. Structural descriptors are not v2 reconstruction accuracy. Associations cannot diagnose causation or select a replacement treatment.

excluded_actions: selecting a new sign, layer or dose from these results
